description: Responsive profile selected by matching filename keywords ('mobile', 'tablet', 'desktop') in the game directory. The selection was not grounded in any source inspection.

evidence_payload.extracted_fact: Rune Match uses a portrait responsive profile because the path contains 'mobile'.
evidence_payload.interpretation: Portrait profile is the chosen responsive strategy.

why_this_fails.structural_problem: selection_rule uses a regex over a path fragment; the actual responsive strategy is defined elsewhere (e.g. a Phaser config object). Filename matches are not source resolution.
why_this_fails.documented_failure_mode: apk-evidence-reconstruction-program.md §'Known shortcuts that must fail' bullet 'Regex- or keyword-selected responsive templates.'
